items.html: And after she was diminished, the Emanator sawed her from his back, and raised her up opposite the Panim of ZA. Then AA shone in her, and completed her correction and enlarged her and built her a complete building, like her husband at first. And now the two of them are found truly equal, one like the other — Adam and Eve. And afterward Bina returned to clothe her NNH upon the head of ZA, to make him mochin, as above; and it follows that then the two of them were face to face.
